regions.name: Northern Mexico
visual_identifiers: sparse cacti including saguaro in Sonora
US border infrastructure visible in places

state_distinguishers.Chihuahua: Largest state, Chihuahuan desert, Copper Canyon area distinctive
state_distinguishers.Sonora: Saguaro cactus visible, Sonoran desert, US border feel
state_distinguishers.Nuevo_Leon: Monterrey urban area, Sierra Madre mountains backdrop, most industrialized northern state
state_distinguishers.Baja_California: Pacific coast peninsula feel, very distinctive geography

regions.route_sign_clues: Mexican federal highways use number only or MEX prefix. State highways use state abbreviation.
regions.gemini_hint: Saguaro cactus = Sonora. Industrial urban with mountain backdrop = Monterrey/Nuevo Leon. Pacific peninsula feel = Baja California. Copper Canyon terrain = Chihuahua.
common_false_positives: Desert terrain — shared across northern states

regions.name: Central Mexico
visual_identifiers: dense urban infrastructure near Mexico City
specific central Mexican road sign style

state_distinguishers.Mexico_City: Massive urban sprawl, specific CDMX infrastructure, Metro system visible
state_distinguishers.Puebla: Volcanic peaks visible, Talavera tile architecture, colonial city center
state_distinguishers.Guanajuato: Colonial mining town architecture, colorful buildings on hillsides

regions.route_sign_clues: Mexico City has specific Periferico and Anillo Periférico signage. State highways well signed.
regions.gemini_hint: Massive urban sprawl = Mexico City area. Volcanic peak (Popocatepetl) = Puebla/Estado de Mexico. Colorful colonial hillside town = Guanajuato. Agave fields = Jalisco or Guanajuato.
common_false_positives: Colonial architecture — appears across all central states

regions.name: Pacific Coast

state_distinguishers.Jalisco: Guadalajara urban area, tequila agave fields, mariachi cultural infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Oaxaca: Indigenous architecture, very distinctive colorful markets, Zapotec cultural elements

regions.route_sign_clues: Pacific coast highway (MEX-200) runs along coast.
regions.gemini_hint: Agave fields in rows = Jalisco tequila region. Indigenous colorful markets = Oaxaca. Resort beach infrastructure = Guerrero or Nayarit.
common_false_positives: Tropical vegetation — shared across Pacific coast

regions.name: Gulf Coast and Southeast
visual_identifiers: very lush green jungle in Chiapas

state_distinguishers.Yucatan_Peninsula: Completely flat limestone terrain, Maya ruins signage, specific Yucatan vegetation (low scrub)
state_distinguishers.Chiapas: Dramatic jungle mountains, indigenous Maya culture very visible, most dramatic scenery in Mexico
state_distinguishers.Quintana_Roo: Cancun resort infrastructure, Caribbean coast feel, very developed tourist area

regions.route_sign_clues: Yucatan peninsula has specific highway numbering. Maya site signs very distinctive.
regions.gemini_hint: Completely flat + Maya ruins signs = Yucatan peninsula. Dramatic jungle mountains = Chiapas. Caribbean resort infrastructure = Quintana Roo. Oil infrastructure = Tabasco or Campeche.
